name: Garel Shuttle 3765
description: Garel Shuttle 3765 was a GX1 short hauler on the planet Garel. In 4 BBY, the shuttle landed in Bay 22 of the Garel City Spaceport. Spectres Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger and Chopper heard an announcer mention to spaceport passengers that the shuttle had arrived from Coruscant as they entered a docking bay in search of the courier EG-86.

data.name: Garel Shuttle 3765
data.armament: Turret-mounted double laser cannons (diplomatic version only)
